title: No more slime on flat world
description: this mod disable slime spawning on a flat world with gamerule to turn it on/off
body:
**No Slimes on Superflat world**

**Tired of slime mobs constantly spawning in your Superflat world?**

**No Slimes on Superflat** disables natural slime spawning in flat worlds by default, making your building and survival experience much more peaceful.

Features:

* Prevents slimes from spawning naturally in Superflat worlds.
* Lightweight and server-friendly.
* Toggle slime spawning at any time using a gamerule.
* Works without requiring world regeneration.

### Gamerule

Control slime spawning with:

/gamerule slimspawning true

Enables slime spawning in Superflat worlds.


/gamerule slimspawning false

Disables slime spawning in Superflat worlds.


### Default Behavior

* `slime spawning = false`
* Slimes will not spawn naturally in flat worlds unless the gamerule is enabled.

Perfect for builders, creative projects, skyblock-style maps, and anyone who wants a cleaner Superflat experience without endless slime invasions.
